details.subject: Re: Invoice INV-AC-2347 – September supplies
details.body:
Dear Acme Supplies Billing team,

Thank you for your reminder regarding invoice INV-AC-2347 (September office & lab supplies, PO KL-PO-0912).

We can confirm that your invoice was received by our AP team on October 1. However, as of today it has not yet been recorded in our ERP system — it is still pending processing.

We will process it shortly and no further action is needed from your side at this stage.

Regards,
Kestrel Labs AP
